name: skill-scout
description: Find what you keep re-typing. A read-only helper mines Claude Code, Codex, and Pi session history for requests and corrections that recur across sessions, keeping only human-typed prompts and redacting secrets. The skill turns each pattern into a right-sized proposal (a skill, command, instruction line, hook, or a trigger fix for a skill that is not firing) with a draft name, description, and evidence-cited reason. It never creates anything.
